source_urls: POST https://data.medicaid.gov/api/1/datastore/query/6165f45b-ca93-5bb5-9d06-db29c692a360/0 (rows where reporting_period LIKE '2025%'; only the columns listed in columns_used were requested)

dataset.title: State Medicaid and CHIP Applications, Eligibility Determinations, and Enrollment Data

columns_used.name: state_expanded_medicaid
columns_used.title: State Expanded Medicaid
columns_used.official_definition: Indicates whether state has expanded Medicaid to low-income adults as of the reporting period, based on the expansion’s coverage effective date (Y=expanded Medicaid, N=has not expanded Medicaid).

columns_used.name: final_report
columns_used.title: Final Report
columns_used.official_definition: Indicates whether data are from a final report (Y=Final Report, N=Preliminary Report).

columns_used.name: total_medicaid_and_chip_enrollment
columns_used.title: Total Medicaid and CHIP Enrollment
columns_used.official_definition: A point-in-time count of the number of individuals enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP as of the last day of each month. Includes only those individuals who are eligible for comprehensive benefits. This metric is calculated as the sum of Performance Indicator elements 8a and 8h.

columns_used.name: total_medicaid_enrollment
columns_used.title: Total Medicaid Enrollment
columns_used.official_definition: A point-in-time count of the number of individuals enrolled in Medicaid as of the last day of each month. Includes only those individuals who are eligible for comprehensive benefits. This metric is set equal to Performance Indicator data element 8a.

columns_used.name: total_chip_enrollment
columns_used.title: Total CHIP Enrollment
columns_used.official_definition: A point-in-time count of the number of individuals enrolled in CHIP (including separate CHIP and Medicaid-expansion CHIP) as of the last day of each month. Note that since some states use CHIP to extend coverage to adults, this measure is not strictly limited to children in all states. Includes only those individuals who are eligible for comprehensive benefits. This metric is set equal to Performance Indicator data element 8h.

columns_used.name: medicaid_and_chip_child_enrollment
columns_used.title: Medicaid and CHIP Child Enrollment
columns_used.official_definition: A point-in-time count of the number of children enrolled in Medicaid and the number of individuals enrolled in CHIP as of the last day of each month. Note that since some states use CHIP to extend coverage to adults, this measure is not strictly limited to children in all states. Includes only those individuals who are eligible for comprehensive benefits. This metric is calculated as the sum of Performance Indicator elements 8c, 8f, and 8h when 8c and 8f are greater than 0; otherwise, the metric is set equal to 0.

report_selection_rule: One row per state and month. Where both a preliminary (final_report=N, preliminary_or_updated=P) and a final/updated (final_report=Y, preliminary_or_updated=U) report exist, the final/updated one is kept. 'report_used' on every row says which.
caveats: No dollar amounts exist in or were taken from this dataset.

Counts are point-in-time enrolment on the last day of the month, comprehensive-benefit enrollees only, as defined by CMS (see columns_used). Per-row footnotes show where a state departs from that (counts anyone enrolled at any time in the month, includes retroactive enrolments, or includes limited-benefit enrollees). States are therefore not measured identically.

Blank cells and cells reported as 0 are treated as NOT REPORTED and stored as null, never 0. CMS's own definition sets the child measure to 0 when its components are not reported. 'not_reported' on the row says which case applied.
avg_monthly_* is the arithmetic mean of the months that have a value (months_used_* says how many), rounded to one decimal. It is a calculation on CMS figures, not a CMS-published figure.
'Medicaid and CHIP Child Enrollment' is children in Medicaid plus EVERYONE in CHIP; CMS notes that some states cover adults in CHIP, so it is not strictly a child count.

Total Medicaid Enrollment excludes CHIP. The Medicaid drug utilisation file (medicaid_sdud.json) can include prescriptions for Medicaid-expansion CHIP children, and it counts all ages and all benefit types, so a prescriptions-per-1,000-enrollees rate is an approximation whichever denominator is used.
50 states and DC only. The dataset has no rows for Puerto Rico or other territories, although medicaid_sdud.json does carry PR.
Monthly figures are revised by states; values reflect the release named in dataset.release_file.
